defects.evidence: Several bullets use phrases that do not demonstrate ownership or technical depth: ... “Responsible for…”
It sounds implausibly broad, especially for an intern, and “entire ML platform” is not specific enough to evaluate.
It is generic, buzzword-heavy, and provides no evidence of technical work.
Several bullets use phrases that do not demonstrate ownership or technical depth: ... “I worked on…” ... Avoid first person throughout the resume.
Fix the reverse-chronological order of experience
Remove: > Was involved in the process... It is passive and unclear.
Be careful with acronyms such as NGX, KRT, Orion, and Vega. If they are internal technologies, briefly explain their function unless the target employer will recognize them.
Delete: Age: 26 Marital status: Single Hobbies: watching TV, sleeping in These details are unnecessary and can introduce bias.
